supportingReference: User-supplied AR41 shape example; not redistributed

requests.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: transparent train side-elevation sprite for Stationsbord.
Primary request: faithfully enhance the supplied MLGTraffic SNCB AR41 diesel railcar, without redesigning it. The previous trial made it look like a different train; preserve the original AR41 exactly. Improve edge precision and legibility only.
Input images: image 1 is the original MLGTraffic carriage and the edit target. Image 2 shows the actual AR41 illustration family as a supporting shape/proportion reference; use the slim rectangular body, narrow window band, compact yellow rounded cab edge and small bogies. Do not reproduce the app, text, badges, UI or background.
Strict invariants: keep the original carriage's length/height ratio (about 6:1), exact door positions, window count and window spacing, roof shape, lower stripe, underframe and bogie locations. It is a long, low, boxy diesel railcar, not a FLIRT, not a LIMAX, not a modern streamlined electric train.
Cab: a near-vertical flat short silver cab end edged by a narrow curved yellow strip. Small grey cab-side window above the blue stripe. NO large dark windshield wrapping down the side. NO pointed nose, sloping wedge, FLIRT-shaped white cab or tall door.
Body: horizontal grey flat roof with only small subtle vent details; silver-white side. Narrow short rectangular grey windows in a thin charcoal band near the top half, leaving a substantial plain silver panel below. Thin dark-blue stripe along the bottom edge of the body. Simple flat red doors, with modest grey glazing. Small conventional two-axle bogies tucked under the body, simple grey wheel rims, all four wheels visible; no oversized mechanical assemblies.
Style: clean flat railway diagram, mostly solid colours, thin precise dark-grey outlines, restrained flat grey shading. Faithful to the MLGTraffic drawing rather than a photorealistic interpretation. No dramatic lighting, gradients, reflections, gloss, weathering or 3D render. High resolution clean raster, not an enlargement that invents new details.
Framing: one entire carriage in strict orthographic side view, exactly horizontal, both ends fully included; transparent alpha everywhere around it, no ground, no shadows, no labels, no logos, no numbers or letters.
Variant: Mixed-class AB carriage with yellow cab at LEFT, flat gangway at RIGHT. Preserve the two red doorway groups shown in image 1.
